author: GameTrailers
description:
True power, the divine right to rule, is something she was born with. Meet Azula and see the character in action in this latest trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, an upcoming 2D anime action fighting game based on the Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra series, developed by Gameplay Group International in collaboration with Paramount. 


Azula's unraveling psyche and duality turns into her greatest strength, from poise and precision to mellifluous madness. Unlike a certain exiled prince, she settles for nothing less than perfection.


Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC via Steam on July 2, 2026. It is also coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 at a later date.


Preorder on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424420/Avatar_Legends_The_Fighting_Game/

Wishlist on PS5: 
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018989/

Wishlist on Xbox Series X|S: 
https://www.xbox.com/en-us
title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game - Official Azula Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the First Age announcement trailer for the upcoming turn-based strategy card game set in the Neolithic Age. Sacrifice villagers, tame mammoths, and build powerful card synergies to lead your tribe through the threat of the Dark Ages. Will your people stand the test of time? First Age will be available on PC.
title: First Age - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the launch trailer for The Wind's Path, a top-down platformer developed by Endless Project Games. Dash, blast, and fly through different worlds. From floating ruins in the sky to a sci-fi metropolis. Play as Olis, a boy who receives powers to control the wind and travel to other worlds. He meets an alchemist who has lost a set of reality-shifting shards. They work together to recapture the shards before they can cause a catastrophe. The Wind's Path is available now on PC (Steam).
title: The Wind's Path - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the launch window trailer for Stratagem Lost, a turn-based strategy RPG and visual novel hybrid with a gritty punk aesthetic set in a world left broken and paranoid from war. Draft a team of fully unique characters and have them become comrades, turning bonds into power. Overcome freeform, high-intensity strategy encounters bolstered by hand-drawn visuals, professional voice acting, and a stomping nu-metal soundtrack. Stratagem Lost is launching in winter 2026 on PC (Steam).
title: Stratagem Lost - Official Launch Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the character trailer for Mr. Karate, the mysterious karate master with strength and skill beyond compare. His name and visage evoke memories of a fearsome fighter who, long ago, sowed discord throughout South Town. And yet his strength and skill are all his own—a polished practitioner of the Kyokugen style whose sheer might surpasses current head Marco Rodrigues himself. The verdict among all who fall to the mask is brutally clear: what lies beneath is no mere man, but a true tiger unleashed. The face—and mask—of Kyokugen returns on May 27. Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Mr. Karate Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Dead by Daylight x Jason collaboration trailer for a peek at what to expect as Jason comes to the asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined survivors face a bloodthirsty killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror. The Dead by Daylight x Jason collaboration will be available on June 16.
title: Dead by Daylight x Jason - Official Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Gameplay Teaser Trailer for Inferius, a dark fantasy first-person card horror game developed by Lucid Rain Studios. Players will assemble the perfect deck to take on the heads of each of the 9 levels of Hell. Take on horrors from run to run in Inferius, coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Inferius - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Showcase 2026
